name: Drandlesticks (9-10)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
description: Enchanted caltrops blend in with the surrounding masonry.
disable: DC 30 Thievery to safely clear the path.

generalAbilities.name: Stick
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks on to the Drandlesticks

Effect The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 30 Acrobatics check or take (1d4+11) Piercing Damage]{1d4+11 piercing damage, 2d6 precision damage}, and 2d4 Bleed Damage. A creature taking persistent bleed damage from the Drandlesticks takes a -10-foot penalty to its Speed.

Additionally, a creature damaged by the Drandlesticks is targeted by a Command spell (DC 28 Will Saving Throw save) with orders to release everything it's holding; if the creature fails the save and drops what it's holding, there is a 50% chance that the high winds blow the object or objects off the edge of the Colossus.
